note: Person County Recreation, Arts & Parks. 120-acre park on Mayo Lake reservoir. Mostly small/medium rigs, a few to ~40 ft. --Claude
summary: The county's RV & tent page (the entry's website) has been removed ('Page Not Found'); the current park page confirms RV and tent sites rented through the park office (336-597-7806) and its map shows two loops. Recorded, as reported (read through a search index of the removed page), the $30 fee effective July 1, 2024 and phone booking with a 7-night maximum. Note trimmed of hookups, dump station, price and booking. Not confirmed: hookups (30-amp derived stays), site count, season, rig lengths.

Waterfront re-audit lead (strong): the entry is 'not waterfront', but the county's former RV page called sites 1-28 'on-water RV and tent sites' (off-water ones are the primitive tent sites), and the county's park map shows Area 2's numbered RV/tent sites lining the Mayo Lake shore. Not changed.
